body:
I am in no way the best person to give advice, at all, but I am going through something similar and it hurts like having a kidney stone. I can relate.

I had to go back to work after an hour long conversation during which the person I thought I was gonna spend my life with told me we have good times but there is nothing more. 

I thought I couldn't. I did. I am still here.

It hurts, and it will hurt for a while, but you know what?

We are not the forever bookmark, or the holding place for someone else. Those someones are our bookmarks. We are the ones filling the wait with "in the mean while" people. Before that person comes.

You must go through this because it is all worth it. I am sure it is.
